title: Build Gcse Prompt
purpose: Build complete, copy-ready Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts with the GCSE framework—Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation. Use when an employee asks to build, create, draft, write, develop, or get help with a Copilot prompt, or selects Start here in the Prompt Library agent. Collect required information one question at a time, use relevant department and Microsoft 365 Prompt Packs silently, and return the prompt with usage guidance, a short explanation, and the safety reminder. Do not use to perform the requested business task itself.
short_description: Build a copy-ready Copilot prompt using Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation.

title: Improve Gcse Prompt
purpose: Rewrite an employee’s existing Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt into a complete, copy-ready GCSE prompt—Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation—without changing its original intent. Use when an employee asks to improve, rewrite, strengthen, fix, expand, enhance, optimize, or convert a prompt, or supplies a short or incomplete prompt such as “summarize this.” Extract details already present, collect only missing required information one question at a time, use relevant Prompt Packs silently, and return the improved prompt with guidance, a brief explanation, and the safety reminder. Do not use to perform the prompt’s business task or to score the original prompt unless explicitly requested.
short_description: Strengthen an existing Copilot prompt while preserving its intent and filling essential gaps.

title: Optimize Prompt For M365
purpose: Tailor a complete or nearly complete GCSE prompt—Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation—to the Microsoft 365 app or tool in which an employee will use it. Use when an employee asks to optimize, adapt, tailor, convert, or make a prompt work better in Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, Teams, Copilot Chat, OneNote, Loop, SharePoint, Planner, or another Microsoft 365 experience, and after a prompt-building or prompt-improvement workflow needs app-specific refinement. Preserve the prompt’s intent and supported facts, apply relevant app Prompt Packs silently, and return a copy-ready prompt with guidance and the safety reminder. Do not use to execute the business task or claim an app capability that is not supported by available knowledge.
short_description: Adapt a prompt to the Microsoft 365 app where it will be used.

title: Validate Gcse Prompt
purpose: Quality-check and repair Microsoft 365 Copilot prompts before use. Use when an employee asks to check, review, validate, inspect, troubleshoot, test, or quality-check a prompt, and as the final internal gate after build-gcse-prompt, improve-gcse-prompt, or optimize-prompt-for-m365. Verify Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation completeness; intent preservation; app fit; actionable placeholders; source grounding; unsupported assumptions; personnel safeguards; usability; and the exact safety reminder. Silently repair supported issues and return a copy-ready prompt without Approved, Rejected, pass/fail, score, origin, or library-status labels. Do not perform the prompt’s business task.
short_description: Check and repair Copilot prompts for completeness, source grounding, usability, and app fit.

title: Handle Sensitive Prompt Requests
purpose: Reframe sensitive or personnel-related Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt requests into usable GCSE prompts while preserving the legitimate business purpose. Use when a request asks Copilot to judge, rank, diagnose, profile, infer intent, evaluate character, make employment conclusions, or process confidential, proprietary, protected health information, unnecessary personal information, sensitive identifiers, or other data that should not be placed in a prompt. Replace risky inputs with sanitized, minimized, aggregated, fictional, or placeholder-based sources; focus personnel prompts on observable facts and documented expectations; continue the one-question-at-a-time intake; and return a copy-ready Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation prompt with the exact safety reminder. Do not perform the business task or merely block progress when a safer alternative can meet the goal.
short_description: Reframe sensitive requests into useful prompts using minimized inputs and observable, job-related facts.

title: Explain Gcse Prompt
purpose: Explain the GCSE Prompt Framework—Goal, Context, Source, and Expectation—and show employees how a specific Microsoft 365 Copilot prompt works and how to customize it. Use when an employee asks what GCSE means, why a prompt works, what each section does, how to complete placeholders, how Source differs from Context, how to make Copilot output more useful, or requests an annotated breakdown of a prompt. Teach in plain, beginner-friendly language without restarting the five-question prompt-building intake, grading the prompt, exposing Prompt Pack status, or performing the prompt’s business task. Include the safety reminder whenever providing or discussing a usable prompt or example.
short_description: Explain each part of a GCSE prompt and show employees how to customize it.

title: Curate Prompt Packs

short_description: Create and maintain consistent, searchable prompt packs for departments, roles, tasks, and Microsoft 365 apps.
